chunks: We shall call the guards of Hell.

key_terms.الزَّبَانِيَةَ: The guards or keepers of Hell

ai.seo_question: Who are the Zabaniyah mentioned in Surah Al-Alaq?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from divine invitation to coercive force, where the 'Zabaniyah' (keepers of Hell) are summoned to enforce punishment on those who reject the message. It underscores the reality of the afterlife and the specific role of these angelic guardians in executing divine justice, reflecting the balance between mercy and retribution in Islamic theology.
